entities.summary: Jamie Leigh Carey is an American former professional basketball player and current women's basketball coach at the University of Nebraska at Omaha. She played the point guard position for the Connecticut Sun of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) from 2005 to 2008. Carey recently served as the Assistant Director of the USA National Team.
